name: 51537-multiimageprefill-qwen25vl3b-1gpu
hardware: 1x H100 80GB HBM3, one GPU of an a3 node (--gres=gpu:1).
parallelism: TP=1, PP=1, DP=1, one in-process vLLM engine.
architecture: Qwen2_5_VLForConditionalGeneration, bf16, 3.75B params -- a 36-layer decoder (hidden 2048, 16 query / 2 KV heads) behind the standard Qwen2.5-VL vision tower; the full geometry is in the checkpoint's own config.json.
load_profile: concurrent (CLOSED loop), streams=2, bounded at 400 requests with an 1800 s safety cap, warmup the first 30% by completion. Two streams is deliberate: the request should meet an uncontended engine rather than a queue.
workload: single turn: eight distinct synthetic 896x1344 JPEGs plus a 16-token instruction, answered in exactly 8 tokens with ignore_eos. 896 and 1344 are both multiples of patch 14 x merge 2, so smart_resize rounds nothing and each image is 1536 merged vision tokens; a request is 12,339 prompt tokens of which 99.6% is picture. The sources, per-image seeds, content and JPEG quality are in `scenario.json`; guidellm drives the engine in-process through its `vllm_python` backend, so there is no HTTP hop.
purpose: A vision assistant captioning eight-photo batches with short answers for two concurrent users on a single GPU.
launch:
# The engine command line for the commit pinned in setupcard.md. Everything not named here is an
# engine default.

model: Qwen/Qwen2.5-VL-3B-Instruct

# The engine default is ONE image per prompt, so without this line every request in the declared
# scenario is rejected before it reaches the engine.
# INLINE JSON, not an indented block: the config reader is line-based and skips every line
# starting with a space, so a block-form dict silently never reaches the engine.
limit-mm-per-prompt: {"image": 8}

tensor-parallel-size: 1

# The plainest power of two above the declared 12,339-token prompt; the checkpoint's own 128k
# window would reserve KV this item never touches.
max-model-len: 16384
